marks.text: a border engrailed

countries.meaning: Dulo-Dulo's filigree bridge joins its two tree-cities.
countries.blazon: A field of deep wood with a chief (a band across the top, two sevenths of the height) of amber sap edged by an engrailed line of small inward scallops. A filigree bridge in elven silver, large in the field below the chief. A narrow border engrailed of elven silver.

countries.name: Heron

primary_charge.name: a heron
primary_charge.meaning: the heron of the forest pools (canting on Heron)

marks.text: a border engrailed

countries.meaning: Heron bears a heron, canting on its name: the forest pools where its council meets.
countries.blazon: A field divided diagonally from the upper hoist corner, mist grey above and deep wood below, by an engrailed line of small inward scallops. A heron in moon white, large in the centre. A narrow border engrailed of elven silver.

countries.name: Herrodon

primary_charge.name: an open-topped roost tower
primary_charge.meaning: the dragon roosts the elves command

marks.text: the leaf circlet: a silver circlet of upright leaves

countries.meaning: Herrodon bears the open-topped dragon roost under the leaf circlet of its queen, acclaimed in the hall: the hill realm that commands dragons and is Andos Enda's old rival.
countries.blazon: A field divided diagonally from the upper hoist corner, hill green above and night slate below, by an engrailed line of small inward scallops. An open-topped roost tower in elven silver, large in the centre. Above the charge a circlet of upright leaves in elven silver.

countries.name: Sacomananos

primary_charge.name: a single dragon scale
primary_charge.meaning: dragon-scale traded for iron at the gate

marks.text: a border engrailed

countries.meaning: Sacomananos bears a dragon scale: the scale it trades for iron at the Wall gates.
countries.blazon: A plain field of night slate. A single dragon scale in scale gold, large in the centre. A narrow border engrailed of elven silver.

countries.name: Velakton

primary_charge.name: a single dragon wing
primary_charge.meaning: the dragons that guard the halls

marks.text: a border engrailed

countries.meaning: Velakton's dragon wing is the dragons that guard its halls.
countries.blazon: A field divided across, elven silver above and hill green below, by an engrailed line of small inward scallops. A single dragon wing in dragon red, outlined in elven silver, large in the centre. A narrow border engrailed of elven silver.

countries.name: Teste

marks.text: a border engrailed

countries.meaning: Teste bears a dragon egg: the brood of its roosts.
countries.blazon: A field of hill green with a chief (a band across the top, two sevenths of the height) of gorge grey edged by an engrailed line of small inward scallops. A dragon egg in elven silver, large in the field below the chief. A narrow border engrailed of elven silver.

countries.name: Filion

primary_charge.name: a long stair cut into a hillside

marks.text: a border engrailed

countries.meaning: Filion bears the long stair of the halls it cuts into eight hillsides.
countries.blazon: A field divided chevron-wise like a broad roof, gorge grey above and hill green below, by an engrailed line of small inward scallops. A long stair cut into a hillside in elven silver, large in the centre. A narrow border engrailed of elven silver.

countries.name: Andos Enda

primary_charge.name: a boat with a glass canopy

marks.text: a border engrailed

countries.meaning: Andos Enda bears the glass-roofed boat of its water-houses, whose Speaker the houses elect; Lerendor would court it and Herrodon remembers it as a rival.
countries.blazon: A field divided across, lake teal above and deep blue below, by an engrailed line of small inward scallops. A boat with a glass canopy in water silver, large in the centre. A narrow border engrailed of water silver.

countries.name: Perloia

primary_charge.name: a pearl shell clasp
primary_charge.meaning: the shell clasp of their dress (canting on Perloia)

marks.text: a border engrailed

countries.meaning: Perloia bears the pearl shell clasp, canting on its name.
countries.blazon: A plain field of willow green. A pearl shell clasp in pearl white, large in the centre. A narrow border engrailed of water silver.

countries.name: Ossa

marks.text: a border engrailed

countries.meaning: Ossa's crane is its Water-Court, which judges every dispute over weirs and boats.
countries.blazon: A field of pearl white with a base (a band across the bottom, two sevenths of the height) of lake teal edged by an engrailed line of small inward scallops. A crane in deep blue, large, standing on the base. A narrow border engrailed of water silver.

countries.name: Nolorim

primary_charge.name: two peaks with a path between them

marks.text: a border engrailed

countries.meaning: Nolorim bears the pass between two peaks: the Pass-Warden holds office until a vigil is broken.
countries.blazon: A field divided chevron-wise like a broad roof, snow white above and pass grey-green below, by an engrailed line of small inward scallops. Two peaks with a path between them in pine, outlined in snow white, large in the centre. A narrow border engrailed of dawn silver.

countries.name: Nolivorak

primary_charge.name: a carved pass-token on a cord
primary_charge.meaning: the token every courier shows at the gate

marks.text: a border engrailed

countries.meaning: Nolivorak's pass-token is the carved token every courier must show at its gates.
countries.blazon: A plain field of pine. A carved pass-token on a cord in dawn silver, large in the centre. A narrow border engrailed of dawn silver.

countries.name: Endelond

primary_charge.name: a lantern
primary_charge.meaning: the lantern clasp of the coast

marks.text: a border engrailed

countries.meaning: Endelond bears the lantern its houses wear as a clasp.
countries.blazon: A field divided across, quay silver above and rift teal below, by an engrailed line of small inward scallops. A lantern in night sea, large in the centre. A narrow border engrailed of quay silver.

countries.name: The End

primary_charge.name: a long pier running out to sea
primary_charge.meaning: the coast held against the sea

countries.meaning: The End bears a long pier running out to sea: the last land of the coast, a league of house-towers that holds the shore.
countries.blazon: A plain field of night sea. A long pier running out to sea in quay silver, large in the centre.

countries.name: Lccimio

primary_charge.name: a slender shore tower with a lantern roof

countries.meaning: Lccimio bears three lantern towers: a league of house-towers under one Warden-Speaker, the largest on the rift coast.
countries.blazon: A field divided diagonally from the upper hoist corner, rift teal above and night sea below, by an engrailed line of small inward scallops. Three of slender shore tower with a lantern roof, two above one in quay silver, large in the centre.

countries.name: Luv-zhise

marks.text: a border engrailed

countries.meaning: Luv-zhise bears the diving gannet of its sea fishers.
countries.blazon: A field of sea glass with a base (a band across the bottom, two sevenths of the height) of rift teal edged by an engrailed line of small inward scallops. A gannet diving in night sea, large, standing on the base. A narrow border engrailed of quay silver.

countries.name: Lengoli

primary_charge.name: a glass float in a net

marks.text: a border engrailed

countries.meaning: Lengoli's glass float is the glassmakers of its quays.
countries.blazon: A field of rift teal with a chief (a band across the top, two sevenths of the height) of lantern gold edged by an engrailed line of small inward scallops. A glass float in a net in quay silver, large in the field below the chief. A narrow border engrailed of quay silver.

countries.name: Lusteli

marks.text: a border engrailed

countries.meaning: Lusteli bears a breaking wave of the rift sea.
countries.blazon: A field of quay silver with flaunches (two curved segments at hoist and fly) of rift teal edged by an engrailed line of small inward scallops. A breaking wave in night sea, large in the centre. A narrow border engrailed of quay silver.

countries.name: Gala

primary_charge.name: a round pool rimmed in gold, with rain falling into it
primary_charge.meaning: the Mirror of First Rain: the past and the possible glimpsed, and never trusted plainly

marks.text: the endless circlet: a plain gold circlet with no points

countries.meaning: Gala bears the Mirror of First Rain under the endless circlet of a king who reigns as long as he wills: the oldest memory of the elves, which distrusts every prophecy shown too plainly.
countries.blazon: A plain field of court white. A round pool rimmed in gold, with rain falling into it in deep harbour, large in the centre. Above the charge a plain circlet with no points, in deep harbour.

countries.name: North Gala

primary_charge.name: a tall ship with white sails
primary_charge.meaning: the King's Ships in the harbour

marks.text: the endless circlet: a plain gold circlet with no points

countries.meaning: North Gala bears the King's Ships that lie in its harbour.
countries.blazon: A field divided across, court white above and deep harbour below, by an invected line of small outward scallops. A tall ship with white sails in Gala gold, outlined in deep harbour, large in the centre. Above the charge a plain circlet with no points, in deep harbour.

countries.name: Gala Elves

marks.text: the endless circlet: a plain gold circlet with no points

countries.meaning: The Gala Elves bear the fountain of their open courts.
countries.blazon: A field of rain blue with a chief (a band across the top, two sevenths of the height) of court white edged by an invected line of small outward scallops. A fountain in court white, outlined in deep harbour, large in the field below the chief. Above the charge a plain circlet with no points, in deep harbour.

countries.name: The Lands of Light

primary_charge.name: a tall arched doorway with a sun disc resting in its arch
primary_charge.meaning: the sanctuary threshold where the light of the Sea of Gods is received

countries.meaning: The Lands of Light bear the noon-door, a tall doorway with the sun resting in its arch: the sanctuaries nearest the Sea of Gods, led by a Radiant Speaker who is never called a king.
countries.blazon: A field divided across, sanctuary white above and noon gold below, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A tall arched doorway with a sun disc resting in its arch in god-sea blue, large in the centre.

countries.name: Elvana
countries.meaning: Elvana bears a tall open double door: its sanctuary turns no visitor away.
countries.blazon: A field divided across, sanctuary white above and shade blue below, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A tall double door, open in sanctuary gold, outlined in deep red, large in the centre.

countries.name: Igara

primary_charge.name: a tall keeper's hat
primary_charge.meaning: the tall hats of the Keepers

countries.meaning: Igara bears the tall hat of its Keepers.
countries.blazon: A field divided upright, sanctuary gold at the hoist and sanctuary white at the fly, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A tall keeper's hat in deep red, large in the centre.

countries.name: Godrela

primary_charge.name: an almond branch in blossom
primary_charge.meaning: the first spring of the sanctuary year

countries.meaning: Godrela's almond blossom opens its sanctuary year.
countries.blazon: A field of sanctuary white with a chief (a band across the top, two sevenths of the height) of flame orange edged by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. An almond branch in blossom in deep red, large in the field below the chief.

countries.name: Sunweli

primary_charge.name: a swallow
primary_charge.meaning: the pilgrims who return each year

countries.meaning: Sunweli bears the swallow that returns each year, like its pilgrims.
countries.blazon: A field divided diagonally from the upper hoist corner, shade blue above and sanctuary white below, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A swallow in deep red, outlined in sanctuary white, large in the centre.

countries.name: Land of the Sun

primary_charge.name: a square court with a disc set in its pavement
primary_charge.meaning: the sun courts where visitors rest

countries.meaning: The Land of the Sun bears the culture's one sun disc, set in the pavement of a sun court where visitors rest.
countries.blazon: A plain field of sanctuary white. A square court with a disc set in its pavement in sanctuary gold, outlined in deep red, large in the centre.

countries.name: Godson
countries.meaning: Godson bears the tall cypress of its three sanctuary hills.
countries.blazon: A field of sanctuary white with a base (a band across the bottom, two sevenths of the height) of olive edged by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A cypress in olive, large, standing on the base.

countries.name: Beforelands of Gulia

primary_charge.name: a road winding up to a door
primary_charge.meaning: the roads kept open for pilgrims

countries.meaning: The Beforelands of Gulia bear the road winding up to a door: the first sanctuary a pilgrim reaches.
countries.blazon: A field divided diagonally from the upper fly corner, ochre stone above and shade blue below, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A road winding up to a door in sanctuary white, outlined in deep red, large in the centre.

countries.name: Menga
countries.meaning: Menga bears a bee: the sanctuary hives that sweeten the guest's bread.
countries.blazon: A field of shade blue with a reversed pile (a broad wedge rising from the bottom edge to a point near the top) of sanctuary gold edged by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A bee in deep red, on the reversed pile.

countries.name: Sono
countries.meaning: Sono's stone basin is the water of rest given to visitors.
countries.blazon: A field divided chevron-wise like a broad roof, sanctuary gold above and deep red below, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A stone basin of water in sanctuary white, outlined in deep red, large in the centre.

countries.name: Sunny
countries.meaning: Sunny bears the sundial that marks noon for the sanctuary.
countries.blazon: A field of shade blue with a chief (a band across the top, two sevenths of the height) of sanctuary gold edged by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A sundial in sanctuary white, large in the field below the chief.

countries.name: Via
countries.meaning: Via bears the stair-street that is its whole town.
countries.blazon: A field divided across, ochre stone above and olive below, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A stair-street climbing between houses in sanctuary white, outlined in deep red, large in the centre.

countries.name: Lovis
countries.meaning: Lovis's hoopoe nests in its sanctuary gardens.
countries.blazon: A field divided upright, shade blue at the hoist and ochre stone at the fly, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A hoopoe in sanctuary white, outlined in deep red, large in the centre.

countries.name: Sensun

primary_charge.name: a bell
primary_charge.meaning: the noon bell of the sanctuary

countries.meaning: Sensun bears the noon bell of its sanctuary.
countries.blazon: A plain field of shade blue. A bell in sanctuary gold, large in the centre.

countries.name: Sun God Land

primary_charge.name: an open sanctuary book
primary_charge.meaning: the sanctuary book that is the law

countries.meaning: Sun God Land bears the open sanctuary book that is its law, within a gold border.
countries.canon_note: Name under Q-11; no god is shown.
countries.blazon: A field of sanctuary white within a border of sanctuary gold edged by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. An open sanctuary book in deep red, large within the border.

countries.name: Godland

primary_charge.name: a door with a sword laid on the ground before it
primary_charge.meaning: no weapon passes the sanctuary door

countries.meaning: Godland bears a door with a sword laid on the ground before it: no weapon passes its threshold.
countries.canon_note: Name under Q-11; no god is shown.
countries.blazon: A field divided diagonally from the upper hoist corner, sanctuary gold above and deep red below, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A door with a sword laid on the ground before it in sanctuary white, outlined in deep red, large in the centre.

countries.name: Godton
countries.meaning: Godton's tall staff is the pilgrims' road through its three sanctuaries.
countries.blazon: A field of shade blue with a base (a band across the bottom, two sevenths of the height) of ochre stone edged by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A tall pilgrim's staff in sanctuary white, large, standing on the base.

countries.name: Flame

primary_charge.name: a single tall flame
primary_charge.meaning: the flame that names the realm (canting on Flame)

countries.meaning: Flame bears a single tall flame, canting on its name.
countries.blazon: A plain field of deep red. A single tall flame in sanctuary gold, large in the centre.

countries.name: Sali
countries.meaning: Sali's crocus is its saffron fields.
countries.blazon: A field divided chevron-wise like a broad roof, sanctuary white above and ochre stone below, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A crocus in deep red, large in the centre.

countries.name: Helen
countries.meaning: Helen bears the gazelle of its open hills.
countries.blazon: A field of olive with a chief (a band across the top, two sevenths of the height) of sanctuary white edged by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A gazelle in sanctuary white, large in the field below the chief.

countries.name: Heaven
countries.meaning: Heaven bears the flame-lamp that lights its stair-streets toward the Sea of Gods.
countries.blazon: A field of sanctuary white with a reversed pile (a broad wedge rising from the bottom edge to a point near the top) of shade blue edged by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A flame-lamp on a stand in sanctuary gold, on the reversed pile.

countries.name: Him
countries.meaning: Him bears the noon brazier of its sanctuary.
countries.blazon: A field divided across, deep red above and sanctuary gold below, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A brazier in sanctuary white, outlined in deep red, large in the centre.

countries.name: Dreamland

primary_charge.name: a hound asleep
primary_charge.meaning: rest and dreams for the visitor (canting on Dreamland)

countries.meaning: Dreamland bears a hound asleep: rest and dreams for the visitor, canting on its name.
countries.blazon: A field divided diagonally from the upper fly corner, shade blue above and sanctuary white below, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A hound asleep in deep red, outlined in sanctuary white, large in the centre.

countries.name: Dein Lands
countries.meaning: The Dein Lands bear the striped canopy that shades their guests across four states.
countries.blazon: A field divided upright, olive at the hoist and sanctuary gold at the fly, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A striped shade canopy in sanctuary white, outlined in deep red, large in the centre.

countries.name: Hengyang
countries.meaning: Hengyang bears the garland of linked rings: the Council of the Chain where every isle sends a Speaker.
countries.blazon: A field divided across, terrace white above and isle teal below, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A garland of linked rings in isle gold, outlined in deep lagoon, large in the centre.

countries.name: Soyano

primary_charge.name: an arched door standing in the shallows
primary_charge.meaning: a sanctuary open to the sea

countries.meaning: Soyano bears an arched door standing in the shallows: a sanctuary open to the sea.
countries.blazon: A plain field of isle teal. An arched door standing in the shallows in terrace white, large in the centre.

countries.name: Tangsie
countries.meaning: Tangsie bears the spotted ray of the channel between its isles.
countries.blazon: A field divided upright, isle gold at the hoist and deep lagoon at the fly, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A spotted ray in terrace white, outlined in deep lagoon, large in the centre.

countries.name: Wenyene
countries.meaning: Wenyene's cuttlefish is its lagoon.
countries.blazon: A field of terrace white with a chief (a band across the top, two sevenths of the height) of coral rose edged by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A cuttlefish in deep lagoon, large in the field below the chief.

countries.name: Pinion
countries.meaning: Pinion bears the egret of its shallows.
countries.blazon: A field divided diagonally from the upper hoist corner, deep lagoon above and isle teal below, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. An egret in terrace white, large in the centre.

countries.name: Sus

primary_charge.name: a bronze bell on a frame

countries.meaning: Sus bears the tide-court bell.
countries.blazon: A field of terrace white with a base (a band across the bottom, two sevenths of the height) of isle teal edged by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A bronze bell on a frame in deep lagoon, large, standing on the base.

countries.name: Tei
countries.meaning: Tei's abalone is its shell-divers.
countries.blazon: A plain field of deep lagoon. An abalone shell in isle gold, large in the centre.

countries.name: Armic
countries.meaning: Armic bears a jellyfish of the warm currents.
countries.blazon: A field divided chevron-wise like a broad roof, isle teal above and terrace white below, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A jellyfish in coral rose, outlined in terrace white, large in the centre.

countries.name: Hel
countries.meaning: Hel bears the silk sail of its trade.
countries.blazon: A field divided diagonally from the upper fly corner, coral rose above and deep lagoon below, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A silk sail in terrace white, large in the centre.

countries.name: Ofos
countries.meaning: Ofos bears the reed pipes of its sanctuary music.
countries.blazon: A field of deep lagoon with a reversed pile (a broad wedge rising from the bottom edge to a point near the top) of isle gold edged by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A set of reed pipes in terrace white, outlined in deep lagoon, on the reversed pile.

countries.name: Hol
countries.meaning: Hol bears the colonnade that faces its sea.
countries.blazon: A field divided across, isle gold above and isle teal below, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A colonnade facing the sea in deep lagoon, large in the centre.

countries.name: Poyang

primary_charge.name: a terrace stair rising from the water

countries.meaning: Poyang, the largest isle realm, bears the terrace stair rising from the water to its five sanctuaries.
countries.blazon: A field of isle teal with a chief (a band across the top, two sevenths of the height) of isle gold edged by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A terrace stair rising from the water in terrace white, large in the field below the chief.

countries.name: Heilmon
countries.meaning: Heilmon bears a comb set with pearls.
countries.blazon: A plain field of coral rose. A comb set with pearls in terrace white, large in the centre.

countries.name: Yungin
countries.meaning: Yungin's sea-lily is its reef garden.
countries.blazon: A field divided upright, terrace white at the hoist and isle teal at the fly, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A sea-lily on its stalk in coral rose, outlined in terrace white, large in the centre.

countries.name: Rana

primary_charge.name: a terrace lamp
primary_charge.meaning: the lamps of the sea terraces

countries.meaning: Rana bears the lamp of its sea terraces.
countries.blazon: A field of deep lagoon with a base (a band across the bottom, two sevenths of the height) of coral rose edged by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A terrace lamp in isle gold, large, standing on the base.

countries.name: Loyol
countries.meaning: Loyol bears the silk kite of its festival.
countries.blazon: A field divided diagonally from the upper hoist corner, isle gold above and terrace white below, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A silk kite in deep lagoon, large in the centre.

countries.name: Biggen
countries.meaning: Biggen's skiff is the ferry between the isles.
countries.blazon: A field divided chevron-wise like a broad roof, deep lagoon above and isle teal below, by a rayonny line of alternating straight and flame-shaped rays. A lagoon skiff in isle gold, outlined in deep lagoon, large in the centre.

countries.name: Goldoroth

primary_charge.name: a fire-mountain with a plume of flame
primary_charge.meaning: the Fire-Mountain above Cocanoor, whose nature the orcs do not speak of

marks.text: the tusk crown: a circlet of upturned tusks

countries.meaning: Goldoroth, the high gold-land, bears the Fire-Mountain under the tusk crown of a Warking who holds the throne until a stronger orc breaks him in the ring.
countries.blazon: A plain field of obsidian. A fire-mountain with a plume of flame in lava red, large in the centre. Above the charge a circlet of upturned tusks in lava red.

countries.name: Sungodor

primary_charge.name: a fire in a stone bowl
primary_charge.meaning: the clan fire that never goes out

countries.meaning: Sungodor bears the clan fire that never goes out.
countries.blazon: A field divided across, ash black above and lava red below, by a raguly line of lopped-branch stubs. A fire in a stone bowl in sulphur, large in the centre.

countries.name: Dark Gate

primary_charge.name: a black ridge split by a narrow gap
primary_charge.meaning: the dark gate in the ridge (canting on Dark Gate)

countries.meaning: Dark Gate bears the black ridge split by its narrow gap, canting on its name.
countries.blazon: A field divided chevron-wise like a broad roof, ember orange above and ash black below, by a raguly line of lopped-branch stubs. A black ridge split by a narrow gap in obsidian, outlined in bone, large in the centre.

countries.name: Zuriath

primary_charge.name: a ring of upright stakes
primary_charge.meaning: the ring where a Warking is broken by a stronger challenger

countries.meaning: Zuriath's ring of stakes is the challenge ring where its chiefs are made and broken.
countries.blazon: A field of ash grey with a chief (a band across the top, two sevenths of the height) of obsidian edged by a raguly line of lopped-branch stubs. A ring of upright stakes in bone, large in the field below the chief.

countries.name: Bold
countries.meaning: Bold bears the war-horn that musters the clans.
countries.blazon: A field divided diagonally from the upper hoist corner, lava red above and obsidian below, by a raguly line of lopped-branch stubs. A curved war-horn in bone, large in the centre.

countries.name: Gord

primary_charge.name: a skull on a cairn of stones
primary_charge.meaning: the cairn of skulls where the clan honours its dead

countries.meaning: Gord bears the skull cairn where the clan honours its dead: the only skull in the arms of the Dark Lands.
countries.blazon: A plain field of ash grey. A skull on a cairn of stones in ash black, large in the centre.

countries.name: Bordon
countries.meaning: Bordon bears the anvil: a hold kept separate by its own forge and its own ring.
countries.blazon: A plain field of coal. An anvil in steel, large in the centre.

countries.name: Dreson

primary_charge.name: forge tongs holding a glowing bar
primary_charge.meaning: iron worked for Dondor and for sale

countries.meaning: Dreson's tongs hold a glowing bar: iron worked for Dondor and sold to anyone else.
countries.blazon: A field divided across, iron above and rust below, by a raguly line of lopped-branch stubs. Forge tongs holding a glowing bar in forge orange, outlined in steel, large in the centre.

countries.name: Beriath

primary_charge.name: a stack of ingots
primary_charge.meaning: iron prices set at the Free Moot

countries.meaning: Beriath bears the ingots it brings to the Free Moot.
countries.blazon: A field of coal with a chief (a band across the top, two sevenths of the height) of rust edged by a raguly line of lopped-branch stubs. A stack of ingots in steel, large in the field below the chief.

countries.name: Britadon
countries.meaning: Britadon bears the single hammer of its smith-chiefs.
countries.blazon: A field divided diagonally from the upper hoist corner, slag green above and coal below, by a raguly line of lopped-branch stubs. A single forge hammer in steel, large in the centre.

countries.name: Dulundur

primary_charge.name: a ring of iron set with nine studs
primary_charge.meaning: the Free Moot of the holds

countries.meaning: Dulundur bears the studded iron ring of the Free Moot of the holds, which meets there to settle tolls and iron prices.

engine_facts: Dynamic tags D01 to D75 are a shared pool (zz_zin_dynamic_countries.txt, dynamic_tags = yes); the installed game ships no flag file for them.
start_civil_war and create_dynamic_country both run an effect block on the new country (effects_documentation.md), so every creation site can set_cosmetic_tag there.

A dynamic country keeps original_tag = its parent; ZIN ships no ideology flag variants (asset manifest section 6), so without a cosmetic tag a breakaway would show its parent's flag or the D-tag fallback (probe AP5).
dynamic.rule: Every script that creates a dynamic country sets a cosmetic tag in the same effect block. A story creation uses its named cosmetic tag (story list). Any other creation uses zin_dyn_<PARENT>_<kind> whose design is derived from the parent record and its culture grammar by the algorithm below. The D-tag base files are a fallback the build forbids reaching.

breakaway.when: A civil war breakaway (start_civil_war) or a rebel realm splitting from a parent.
steps: Counterchange the field: swap the order of the two field tinctures; a plain field takes the primary charge's tincture and the charge takes the field's.
Keep the primary charge: the breakaway claims the same realm. Drop the secondary charge.

Add the culture's breakaway mark (difference.breakaway_mark): a border in the culture's line, tinctured with difference.dissent_tincture. A Concord dominion instead shows the charter border broken open at the top; a Free Crown shows its crown torn from the beast.
Keep the family mark (Aen's label, the family line). Never add or remove a people mark.
Apply the ideology overlay of the breakaway's ruling ideology.
Re-run contrast, palette and near-duplicate checks; the derived flag must be at least 10 of 64 from its parent.

released.when: A land given its own realm (create_dynamic_country for a people or province with no tag of its own).
steps: Take the grammar of the released land's majority culture, not the releaser's.
Division: the first entry of the culture's divisions list whose (division, field tinctures) signature is unused in the region.
Field: the first pair of culture tinctures (one metal, one colour) unused with that division in the region.
Primary charge: the first culture charge not used as a primary charge in the region.
Secondary charge: the culture's restoration charge (difference.restoration_charge), small in base: the realm restored.
If the releaser keeps it as a subject, add the releaser's subject mark (charter border, grave base or the releaser's dissent tincture as a narrow border).

formed.when: A union of two or more founders (a formable that is created as a dynamic country).
steps: Impale: divide per pale in the family line of the senior founder; the hoist half carries the senior founder's first field tincture and primary charge, the fly half the junior founder's.
With three or more founders, the fly half is the senior culture's darkest colour charged with the junior founders' primary charges small, two above one.
If the formed realm is a kingdom, the senior culture's crown is placed over the line of impalement.
Never quarter more than four pieces and never tierce in three equal upright bands (a real-world tricolour).

democratic.rule: The metal part of the field becomes the culture's lightest metal; no crown is added.

fascism.rule: The culture's crown is added over the charge; a culture without a crown uses a plain circlet in its lightest metal.

communism.rule: The colour part of the field becomes the culture's darkest tincture and the charge its palest; nothing else changes (no new symbols of the dark powers on a mortal realm).

neutrality.rule: Any crown is removed; the counterchanged field stands alone.

story.name: The Golden Court
story.gate: Aenor succession war, court camp (aenor_court_and_succession section 7)
story.blazon: A field divided across, lamp gold above and lake blue below. A bowl-lamp with one flame in deep lake, large in the centre, under a circlet of five flame-shaped points in deep lake. A plain narrow border of bell bronze.
story.meaning: The court's gold laid over the realm's blue, with the lamp darkened and a bronze border of difference: the party of the gilded halls that sells offices and still claims the crown.

story.name: Aenor of the Faithful
story.gate: Aenor succession war, Faithful camp, before zin_afrit_revealed
story.blazon: A field of Parim white with a base of lake blue. A bowl-lamp with one flame in lamp gold, outlined in deep lake, large in the centre; a round loaf in bell bronze, small, beneath it. A plain narrow border of slate.
story.meaning: The lamp and the loaf of the Deliverer's public charity on white: the camp that puts the faith before the crown. Nothing on it shows who leads the faith.
story.canon_note: Public arms before the reveal: the deny-list of the Worshipdom applies (no eye, chain, ash, mask, veil, serpent, horns, fire-bird, hidden face).

story.name: Aenor of Afrit (the Ashen Throne)
story.blazon: A field divided diagonally, slate above and deep lake below. A bowl-lamp in Parim white whose flame is a plume of grey ash, large in the centre, under a circlet of five flame-shaped points in lamp gold.
story.meaning: After the reveal the lamp of the traveller burns ash: the crown of Aenor held by the god-king the realm worshipped.

story.name: The Stranger's Host
story.gate: Aenor succession war, host camp, before zin_eindil_named

primary_charge.name: a wayfarer's staff with a small lamp hung from its head

story.blazon: A field divided diagonally from the upper hoist corner, Parim white above and lake blue below. A wayfarer's staff bendwise in bell bronze with a small lamp in lamp gold hung from its head.
story.meaning: A traveller's staff carrying the lamp: the host gathered by a stranger from the north whose name is not yet known; nothing shows his blood.

story.name: The Host of Eindil
story.parent: host realm (Selen in the historical path)

primary_charge.name: Aen's label, large, as the whole charge

story.blazon: A plain field of lake blue. Across the upper half a broad label of three square points in Parim white, large. Beneath it a wayfarer's staff in bell bronze with a small lamp in lamp gold, upright.
story.meaning: The label, every Ainic realm's small mark of descent, becomes the whole charge: the host of the son of Ein, son of Aen, whose claim is the line itself; uncrowned until the realm crowns him.

story.name: The Free Dominions
story.blazon: A plain field of lake blue. In chief a narrow label of three short square points in lamp gold. A closed book with clasps in Parim white, large in the centre. A plain narrow border of lamp gold, broken open at the top.
story.meaning: The Charters of Parim held by the dominions themselves: the charter border broken open at the top where the crown once sealed it, and no crown.

story.name: Aenor (the crowned heir of Aen)
story.blazon: A plain field of lake blue. A bowl-lamp with one flame in lamp gold, large in the centre, under an ancient plain circlet of pale gold set with one white stone.
story.meaning: Aenor's own arms under the ancient crown of Aen instead of the lamp-crown: the realm restored to the line it was founded by. Glo and the blue sword are not shown (reserved charges).

story.name: The Dominion of the East
story.blazon: A field of hostel white with a chief of pilgrim gold. A standing lamp in sky blue, large, under a tall plain crown of bread brown; beneath it a hand offering a round loaf in bread brown, small.
story.meaning: The hostel lamp crowned: the pilgrims' realm proclaimed a kingdom of the East; the arms still show only the public faith.

story.name: Great Goldoroth
story.blazon: A plain field of obsidian. A fire-mountain with a plume of flame in lava red within a ring of upright stakes in ash grey, large in the centre, under a circlet of upturned tusks in bone.
story.meaning: The Fire-Mountain inside one challenge ring: every hold that bent to the Warking now stands in his ring.

regional_cliches.rule: banned everywhere (the rejected 19 October sheets put palms across the East)
no primary charge more than twice in a region and never twice in a culture; no charge class above 40 percent of a region with ten or more flags
once in all the East Lands (The Moco)
once per region at most (Gord in the Dark Lands); never for corsairs, never for the dead
at most one per culture (the Lands of Light noon-door, the Land of the Sun's sun court)
no masonry, battlements, crenellation, brick courses or wall towers for the Great Wall of Aenor, which is a mountain range

real_world_flags_and_arms: tricolours: any field of three equal upright or horizontal bands, with or without a charge
stars and stripes: alternating stripes with a canton; stars in a canton or in rows; a ring of stars (including twelve)
crescent and star, a crescent alone
any cross throughout: Nordic (offset), St George, St Andrew saltire, Greek or Latin cross charges, cross pattee, Maltese cross
hammer and sickle, hammer and compasses, crossed tools, cogwheels
eagles in national poses: displayed, double-headed, on a cactus, with a snake

a lion rampant of national type, three lions passant, a rose of the Tudor kind, a fleur-de-lis, a maple leaf, a cedar of the Lebanese kind, a harp of the Irish kind, a red dragon on green and white, a dragon on a diagonal bicolour
a red disc on white; a rising sun with rays to the edges; a sun with a face; a sun over waves; a canoe over a sun over waves; a frigate bird over a sun
a large plain disc or lozenge on a plain field (Japan, Bangladesh, Brazil types)
a yurt roof-wheel, a spoked wheel of eight or twenty-four spokes
a skull and crossbones, a fouled anchor, a compass rose of four points
chequy red and white, lozengy blue and white, gold with red pales, gyronny gold and black (Croatian, Bavarian, Aragonese, Campbell arms)
real_religious_symbols: star of David or any hexagram
ichthys, chalice, dove with olive branch, lamb with banner
eye of Horus, winged sun disc
other_fiction: a white tree with stars and crown
a direwolf, kraken, three-headed dragon, sun pierced by a spear, golden rose on green
forbidden.lettering: No letters, numerals, runes, monograms, mottoes, signatures or maker's marks anywhere on a flag.
forbidden.owner_emblem: Never the owner's ZIN emblem: a square frame with its two diagonals crossed and an upright staff through the centre; no square frame with crossed diagonals in any arms.
names_and_canon: no named New God charge; no figure of Zol, Volgan, Afrit, Elzon, Horos or any named person
no Afrit or Hidden Council sign on the Worshipdom or Aenor public arms (deny-list in the Worshipdom record)
Glo, Horos's blue sword and its shards are reserved charges: owner approval and a story gate are required
no device of Elzon's Order (the Pale Regency) on any living realm
nothing of the wider world (Erdu, Dunda, Haven, Cerio, Lao and the small neighbouring continent)

checks.coverage: every tag in common/country_tags (305 roster tags and D01-D75) and every cosmetic tag in common/countries/cosmetic.txt has a design record and gfx/flags/<TAG>.tga, medium/<TAG>.tga and small/<TAG>.tga; no flag file without a tag

headers.measured_from: installed game gfx/flags/FRA_democratic.tga, medium/FRA_democratic.tga, small/GER.tga and small/FRA.tga (24 October 2026)

checks.palette_fit: k-means on the 82x52 image with k = declared tinctures + 1; every cluster above 6 percent of pixels lies within Delta E 2000 of 12 of a declared tincture of the record (culture palette, declared borrowings, overlord marks)
checks.contrast: primary charge tincture against each field tincture it overlaps: luminance ratio at least 2.2, or the record declares fimbriation
checks.element_budget: marks plus charges at most 4 (5 is a hard failure)
checks.small_signature: (division, field tinctures) unique within a region; at 10x7 the mean Delta E 2000 between any two flags of a region at least 10
checks.unique_design: design_hash (division, line, field, primary, secondary, marks) unique across all records

near_duplicate.hash: 64-bit difference hash (grey 9x8) and 64-bit average hash; distance = larger Hamming distance
near_duplicate.real_world_reference: computed at build time, read-only, from every flag of the installed game gfx/flags (a corpus of real national flags of the 1930s); nothing is copied or stored
near_duplicate.colour_grid: 3x2 mean colour grid; a pair closer than 10 hashes is also compared by grid, mean Delta E 2000 under 18 fails

checks.forbidden_text: record blazons and prompts are scanned for the forbidden vocabulary; the generated large sheet gets an OCR pass that must find no glyphs
checks.canon_gates: reserved charges only in gated records; the Worshipdom and Aenor public arms pass the hidden-identity deny-list
checks.provenance: each sheet has one line in art/source/provenance.jsonl (id, prompt, prompt sha256, record design_hash list, reference images, output, output sha256, review); each flag file has a line in art/source/flags_manifest.json (source sheet, cell, crop box, operations, output sha256)

pipeline.grouping: sheets are filled in order family, culture, region, tag, so one sheet carries one family's grammar; a sheet never mixes the dead or demons with living cultures
pipeline.prompt_frame:
A flat asset sheet of {n} distinct heraldic flags for a medieval-fantasy strategy game, arranged in an exact {cols} columns by {rows} rows grid. The background is solid flat pure black (#000000) everywhere between and around the flags: no glow, no blur, no gradient, no texture. Every flag is a perfectly flat, front-facing rectangle with an aspect ratio of 41 to 26, all the same size, evenly spaced with identical black gutters; no perspective, no waving, no folds, no shadows, no frames, no poles. Painted heraldic style: flat tinctures exactly as named, bold silhouettes with a thin dark outline, a faint woven-cloth texture inside each flag, no gradients, no fine detail smaller than one fortieth of the flag's height. No lettering, no letters, numbers or runes anywhere; no signature or maker's mark; corners and bottom edge hold only plain ground; no real-world religious symbol; no real national flag or coat of arms; no crosses, stars, crescents or eagles; no masonry or battlements. {family_style}
{rows_text}
pipeline.family_style: Family style: {family.mark_text}. Shared palette of this sheet: {palette names}.
pipeline.reference: after the first accepted sheet, the job passes that sheet as a layout-only reference ("copy its black background, grid, flag size and spacing exactly; copy none of its designs")
slicing: Find the 12 flag rectangles by the black-gutter layout check (existing flag-jobs check: expected count, columns, rows, aspect 1.4 to 1.75).
Inset each rectangle by 2 percent on every side to drop edge fringe.
Medium: Lanczos-3 resize of the inset source to 41x26.
Small: box-filter (area) downscale of the inset source to 10x7; this squeezes the 41:26 artwork horizontally as the game's own small flags do.
Write uncompressed 32-bit TGA, bottom-left origin, alpha 255, descriptor as measured (0x08 large and medium, 0x00 small).
No recolouring, palette snapping or redrawing: if a size fails a check, the sheet is regenerated.
